sections.title: An agentic marketing platform for influencer campaigns
sections.summary: An agentic marketing platform that helps agencies run influencer campaigns faster with AI. I designed the core screens, from the dashboard to the inbox, campaigns and creator search, then implemented them with Claude Code, replacing spreadsheets, Gmail and manual tracking with one product.

image.alt: Creator profile panel showing opt-in status, follower count, engagement, a discount code, notes and recent content

sections.heading: Agencies needed a better way to manage influencer partnerships at scale.
sections.lead: Through research with marketing agencies, three main reasons emerged.

pillars.title: Fragmented tools
pillars.text: Outreach, contracts and performance lived in different tools, making it hard to see the full picture.

pillars.title: Context
pillars.text: Without context, campaign data was just numbers. It didn’t show what was working or why.

pillars.title: Time
pillars.text: Agencies didn’t have time to dig through dashboards to find actionable insights.

sections.label: Leading design from 0 to 1
sections.heading: Research first, then the core experience.
sections.body:
I led the product design for Cheerful AI’s core experience: dashboard metrics, active campaigns and creator opt-in flows. The focus was on clarity and action, surfacing total revenue, engagement and campaign health at a glance so agencies could act quickly.

The work started with user research and journey mapping to understand how agencies actually run campaigns today.

media.alt: Research board with a new user flow, notes from three interviews and a mind map of findings

sections.heading: From existing tools to first sketches.
sections.lead: A competitive analysis mapped how other platforms handle creator search, lists, email sequences and tracking. Sketches then worked through the campaign creation process before anything moved to high fidelity.

image.alt: Competitive analysis board comparing screenshots of other platforms’ flows, from creator search to email sequencing, with sticky-note takeaways
Hand-drawn sketches of the campaign creation screens

items.caption: Sketches of the campaign creation process

columns.heading: I designed every core screen
columns.body: From the sketches, I designed the screens agencies use every day: the dashboard, inbox, campaigns flow and creator search. Each one follows the same focus on clarity and action.

columns.heading: Then I built them with Claude Code
columns.body: As the team’s UX engineer, I implemented my own designs using Claude Code, taking each screen from design to working product myself.

sections.heading: Performance and relationships in one view.
sections.body:
The platform enables marketing agencies to run influencer campaigns for brands with clearer visibility into performance and creator relationships.

Key flows, from campaign creation to opt-in tracking, are designed to reduce friction and support faster decisions.

media.alt: Dashboard with total revenue, average engagement rate, posts detected and total opt-in rate, an active campaigns table, a reach chart, recent posts and recent opt-ins

sections.heading: Every creator conversation, with AI drafts.
sections.body:
Managing creator replies across dozens of campaigns meant endless tab-switching and manual copy-pasting.

The inbox centralizes all creator communication in one place, with AI-generated draft replies that match the campaign’s tone, so teams can review, edit and send in seconds instead of starting from scratch every time.

media.alt: Inbox with a list of creator threads on the left and an open conversation with an AI-drafted reply on the right

sections.heading: A guided 7-step campaign flow.
sections.body:
Campaign creation was previously scattered across spreadsheets, email threads and separate tools.

The campaigns flow brings everything into a single guided 7-step process, from defining the campaign type and setting up email sequences to selecting creators and launching, giving teams full visibility and control from one place.

media.alt: Campaign page listing creators with their email, address, status, last contact date and actions

sections.heading: From hours of scrolling to minutes.
sections.body:
Finding the right creators used to mean hours of manual scrolling on Instagram and TikTok.

The AI-powered creator search lets teams enter a handle and instantly surface similar profiles, with follower counts, posting frequency and engagement data, cutting discovery time from hours to minutes.

media.alt: Creator search results for similar profiles, each row showing followers, total posts, posting frequency and a Save button

sections.heading: From concept to a platform used by real agencies.
sections.lead: The design replaced spreadsheets, Gmail and manual tracking with one product. Usability testing and client feedback confirmed that core tasks could be done without guidance and that AI outreach cut campaign setup time.

pillars.title: Agency lead
pillars.text: “We were able to get through setup and launch a campaign in one sitting. That used to take us days across different tools.”

pillars.title: Marketing team
pillars.text: “The AI drafts save us hours. We tweak the tone and hit send instead of starting from a blank email every time.”

pillars.title: Client feedback
pillars.text: “New people on the team picked it up without training. Everything we need is in one place now.”
